summary: Iter 124: verified IC-2 bank CSV import, LCA-1 weekly scrape cron + endpoints, and LF-2 Mailbox UI (Round 1 of spec closure). 9/9 pytest cases pass. Frontend /app/letters renders with lf2-mailbox-root, heading 'Your Letter Mailbox', chains + drafts + inline edit/send, and sidebar link.

IC-2: Cross-household participant_id → 404 (Core-1 access denied, semantically equivalent to 401/403) ✓
LCA-1: Cron alive: backend.err.log shows 'lca1 weekly scrape cron tick recorded: <uuid>' ✓ (LCA1_SCRAPE_INTERVAL_SECONDS default 604800)
run-now with super-admin path not exercised (per E1 note, TOTP path skipped for testing_agent). Endpoint auth guard verified via negative case.
LF-2: UI: /app/letters renders lf2-mailbox-root, PageIntro 'Your Letter Mailbox', chain sections (lf2-chain-<id>), drafts (lf2-draft-<id>) with Edit/Save/Send buttons ✓
Sidebar: 'Letters Mailbox' link under Guided Journeys, href=/app/letters ✓

critical_code_review_comments: ic2.bank_csv_import: date parsing loop assigns `date` variable but overshadows Python `datetime.date` (aliased as `_dt`); works correctly but the variable name shadow is subtle — could rename to `parsed_date`.

ic2.bank_csv_import: relies on `_db.invoice_checks` collection for open invoices, but the correlate engine writes into `_db.invoices`. Two collections with overlapping semantics — matched_count will be 0 for anything ingested via /correlate. Confirm intended collection or unify.

lca1.start_lca1_cron: only creates one task at import time via `asyncio.create_task` inside a sync function — should be called from FastAPI startup event (per docstring). Verify server.py wraps it in the startup handler, otherwise create_task without a running loop raises. Log shows it did fire so it is OK, but worth an assertion in server.py.
lca1.scrape/runs: no pagination/limit param (hardcoded 20). Fine for v1.

LettersMailbox.jsx: Send button uses `draft.recipient_email` (from the loaded draft) rather than the local `recipient` state to gate the disabled attr — after inline edit the local recipient may be set but disabled state won't update until save. Minor UX polish.
